name: Governed Scale Control Effectiveness and Exception Automation
objective: Automate detection, routing, escalation and closure tracking for control failures and material evidence exceptions while preserving human authorization for conformance, CAPA closure and release decisions.
escalation_rules: unresolved due date → escalation to control owner and governance
material security breach → suspend affected scope
fail_closed_conditions: exception cannot be linked to evidence scope
material anomaly suppressed without authorized disposition
automated rule bypassed without audit record
claim released while supporting exception is unresolved
claim_boundary: Automation identifies and routes exceptions; it does not independently certify environmental truth, premium status, regulatory approval or product release.
